# Jarvis by Chiefly

> Jarvis is your computer’s chief of staff. It remembers what matters, handles the boring stuff, and keeps your business yours. It lives on your computer, not in someone’s cloud.

Jarvis is coming soon for Mac and Windows. You pay once. There is no subscription. Joining the waitlist is free.

## What you get

- It remembers what matters and keeps your goals in sight.
- It handles the boring stuff.
- It is yours. You own it. You don’t rent it.
- Students can start with it on day one and keep it through graduation. One payment covers all four years.

## What we stand for

- People before profit.
- You own it. You don’t rent it.
- It works for you, and only you.
